floorPlans.note: Built-up totals include the balcony. Area ranges follow the printed values. Both total columns for 3 BR Type A print 1,384.99 sq ft even though the suite and balcony figures vary. The selector retains the printed total. Confirm the size of the specific apartment.

review.gallery: 8 Nshama design renders and 2 actual construction photos from the developer’s September 2026 project update. 1 additional DLD images are from the dated project album mirrored by Continental Club. The shared-looking living-room scene and the photo that foregrounds both neighbouring structures were omitted. The remaining dated photos follow the project-specific update and inspection sources.
review.location: The Nshama master-plan panel and community estimate table are on physical pages 4 and 7. The project pin is from Continental Club’s project 3144 listing and aligns with the marked plot sector. The separate reused locator in the page schema was excluded.
review.floorPlans: 15 complete sheets, with totals visually checked against the original drawing panels. Both total columns for 3 BR Type A print 1,384.99 sq ft even though the suite and balcony figures vary. The selector retains the printed total.

unavailable: Verified visitor entrance, finished-building photos and current unit-specific measured areas.
